gap.unlocks: Fills the lower cells of the atlas for the 31 graphs with no 4-cycle the first table left out.
gap.context: SKETCH: one conjunct per graph, route i is conjunct i + 1; each says no circuit has s - 1 gates. Routes: exhaustive enumeration or a SAT certificate at size s - 1, or gate elimination by restricting inputs. In-house searches did not finish for some graphs; bounds reached are in routes/lgp/after/statements/fam31.routes.md, line k (computed, not checked). Namespace: PEqualNP.MetaComplexity. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
